items.en: "Easy $global.jethroName. Ulmus only had good intentions I'm sure."
"No, I think Ulmus is behind it. We should do an active scan on his brain."
"Perhaps you're right, he does look pretty innocent."
"So you admit you 'helped' Menes buy a fake relic from the Pathers!"
"Ulmus is behind it. We should perform an active scan on his brain."
"On second thought, I don't think Ulmus had anything to do with it."
"Ah... yes, that's right. We really should try the brain-interfacer."
"'Brain-interfacer'? What is this nonsense $global.jethroName?"
"Yet you ran. Right back to your Pather masters on Chalcedon."
"But you ran, Ulmus. Right back to your Pather masters here on Chalcedon."
"If, and only if, $global.jethroName, he helps us. Otherwise he goes to the Inquisitors."
"Show him, Ulmus. It's us or the Inquisitors."
"Easy $global.jethroName. Ulmus only had good intentions I'm sure."
"Why wait for them? My techs can simply open up his brain..."
"I apologize, Ulmus. It was a joke. I believe you."
"$global.jethroName, look, we're going to have to switch this up."
"No. I, uh, believe Ulmus only ever had good intentions. Right?"
"Yes. I'm sure you can handle it."
"They must have threatened you, Ulmus. You wouldn't hurt anybody."
"Knight Bornanew is right. You're guilty and deserve punishment."
"We want to help. Tell us who did this to you, Ulmus."
"The Knights punish heretics. Forgiveness is for God."
"Show him, Ulmus. Who's behind this. Where."
"This is how you make it out of here alive, Ulmus. Show him."
"Um, $global.jethroName?"
"$global.jethroName! What are you doing?"
Turn around, slowly
"Wrestling Sedge. But he's dead."
"I recall handling that problem already."
Subvocalize a call to your security team
"We were just having a chat with Mister Pond here."
"Sedge. I should have shot you when I had the chance."
Draw your weapon
"Unlucky? Why?"
Draw your weapon and stop Sedge
Check on Bornanew
"Go to Menes. Confess. He's fool enough to forgive you."
"Go to Menes. Confess. He's kind enough to forgive you."
"$global.jethroName, will the Knights take this man?"
"You did this to yourself. Now deal with it."
"Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will."
"As you like, $global.jethroName. Pond is your responsibility."
"No. Pond earned his own fate and I'll have it no other way."
"We're done." (leave)
"We're going to the $bffi_patherStationSystem."
"Fear not, $global.jethroName. My $shipOrFleet will be ready."
"When I end this, $global.jethroName, it is the Path that shall fear me."
Nod acknowledgement
"$global.jethroName. I welcome your counsel."
"We're going to break these Pathers wide open."
"So, how do you think we should approach this one?"
"Shall we ask nicely how they did it?"
"These are fanatics. They'd sooner die than talk."
"'Carefully," isn't enough. You suggest we talk to them?"
"I shall proceed with the operation."
"We could simply blast this station apart and sift the wreckage for datastores and prisoners."
"You've given me a lot to think about."
"You suggest that leniency will prompt cooperation? From Pathers?"
"Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you."
"If I do not prove absolute domination of my enemy, they will not fear me."
"I shall consider this."
"I expected more talk of leniency from you, $global.jethroName."
"I believe that Archcurate Jaspis would approve of this 'message'."
"I shall do as you ask - so far as is possible."
"If they force me to, I will do what is necessary."
"Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you."
"I'll just win the battle without hurting anyone, is that what you want?"
"If they force me to, I will do what is necessary."
Consult with $global.jethroName
Handle this one yourself
TODO continue
"$global.jethroName. That was a brave thing you did on Chalcedon."
"$global.jethroName. That was a stupid thing you did on Chalcedon."
"You should thank the medical team, they're the ones that saved you."
"We're in the $bffi_patherStationSystem. There's a Pather base."
"I intend to negotiate with the Pather in charge here."
"I intend to send a marine raid. Seize datastores, destroy the forge."
"I intend to attack directly. Destroy the station."
"Of course."
"I will decide when he needs rest, doctor."
"I've come a long way looking to purchase something... unique." (lie)
"Your nanoforge assembled a very interesting item. I have questions."
"I come as fellow-walker of the Faith... I have grave concerns."
"Light or no, I am honest. You sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful."
"You speak of sin while you sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful?"
"Blind am I, and faithless? I see you sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful."
"If it is an honest fight you want, then why the false relics scheme?"
"Why are you so willing to violate the tenets of your faith for Wrestling Sedge?"
"Your 'skulduggery' is undone anyway. I found your relic and tracked it to here."
"We seek not your death, but to stop a scheme that will itself kill countless Faithful." (explain)
"I can destroy you. Choose to lose all - or make a deal, and lose little." (explain)
"You're a hopeless fanatic. There is no reasoning with you."
"Your heresy has twisted your faith. There is no reasoning with you." (cut the comms)
"Then praise the Path! You're free of the beast and his schemes."
"It is I who shot Sedge. Though I'm less machine than you'd hope."
"It is I who killed Sedge. After he murdered the man I was speaking to."
Propose terms
"I truly hoped that would have gone better."
"Good. Now we can do this my way."
"Accept my terms. It is the Path of least harm for all."
Carry out the ruse to seize datastores and destroy the nanoforge
"I have given the Path a great gift, and that deal has held."
"Let's make it easy. I'll give you 50,000 credits to assist your relocation."
"I have walked the Pilgrim's Path. We may not see eye-to-eye, but I am a fellow walker."
"I have walked the Path. I support your cause, in the end, even if you don't believe it."
"I have been merciful in my actions, whatever you think of my beliefs."
"Surely my humanitarian reputation precedes me."
"My patience is spent. There can be no deal, and that's on you." (cut comms)
"Your heresy has corrupted you too far. I pray the infinite accepts you." (cut comms)
"Those are the terms. My wrath is great and won't be long contained."
"My capital ships will break your station apart. You have no chance of victory."
"I killed Wrestling Sedge, and I would kill you without remorse. The choice is yours."
"You know of me. My reputation for ruthlessness precedes me."
"I am a great enemy known to all Pathers. How could you doubt my threat?"
"Trust that I am mercenary. I'm avoiding a fight to save credits."
"My patience with you is spent." (cut comms)
"I cannot deal with a mad heretic. Pray now for a quick death." (cut comms)
Assemble your officers to plan a raid to capture the nanoforge
"$global.jethroName. What is it?"
"So this Keepfaith is your Pather mole?"
Order it done
"What have you found?"
"Clean up some representative samples for me."
Go to the medbay
"Over the what?"
"So this Keepfaith is your Pather mole."
"Get some rest. We're going to Tartessus."

Shuttle down to the cathedral with $global.jethroName
Board what passes for transport on Tartessus
"Are you telling me there is going to be trouble?"
"So what's wrong with the 'Mundanians'?"
"What distinguishes the Ineffablist doctrine?"
"'Idolators', huh. And what do they call you?"
"You fight over this? It sounds interminable."
"So you're just going to walk in, unarmed, and make an arrest?"
"You mention this now? We should have prepared."
"Opposition? Shall I call in a squad of marines?"
"Not to worry. I'm prepared." (pat your weapon)
"With your injury... you're sure you want to do this?"
"So you're just going to walk in, unarmed, to arrest a curate?"
"I'll, um, follow your lead."
"Must it? You're putting a lot of faith in others choosing to cooperate."
"I'll protect the two of us, then. If it comes to it."
"I mean no offense, but you're a bit crazy, you know that?"
"I'll follow your lead."
"I'll protect the two of us, then."
